# tcpshield_domain (Resource)

A domain attached to a network and routed to a backend set. TCPShield only serves it once `verified` is true — point a CNAME at the network's `protected_cname` and add its `txt_verification` record.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tcpshield_domain" "play" {
  network_id     = tcpshield_network.main.id
  name           = "play.example.com"
  backend_set_id = tcpshield_backend_set.lobby.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend_set_id` (Number) Backend set the domain forwards to.
- `name` (String) Fully qualified domain name, e.g. `play.example.com`.
- `network_id` (Number) Network the domain belongs to.

### Optional

- `bac` (Boolean) The domain's BAC switch, as shown in the TCPShield panel.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric domain id.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether TCPShield has verified the domain's DNS.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import tcpshield_domain.play <network_id>/<domain_id>
```
